answer: Each identity grafts onto a sponsor's terrace, locking 150 credits while the sponsor locks 50 on the grove ledger. Each sponsor backs at most four identities per epoch: the zenith. The k-th identity through one sponsor pays 20(k-1) extra, burned; 1,000 fakes through 250 sponsors cost 200,000 locked plus 30,000. The grove ledger is checked by auditors, who flag sponsors above the zenith; fraud burns stakes and bans the terrace. A rented-sponsor ring fails because sponsors need established history and risk 50 each; an honest identity pays 150, recovered after a clean epoch.
